meta.name: OCF Value With Volatility Guard Basket V5.6c
meta.objective: Test a cleaner stable cash-flow basket where OCF yield is the primary score and low-volatility is enforced as a risk/coverage guard, not as a separate positive alpha score.

universe.name: PIT candidate pool from bank, utilities/electricity, highway infrastructure and port/rail infrastructure sleeves
universe.construction: Each sleeve must pass its own PIT universe and data availability gate before entering the V5.6c basket constructor.

data.vendor: JoinQuant/DataJQ PIT panels, reviewed sector evidence where available, and JoinQuant real daily open/close execution prices
data.cash_dividend_policy: real cash dividends from JoinQuant STK_XR_XD, net_cash_per_share after 20% tax, paid on ex-date proxy
data.stock_action_policy: bonus/transfer shares adjust local unadjusted-price holdings on ex-date

signals.core_hypothesis: Stable cash-flow sectors should be ranked primarily by operating cash-flow yield, while volatility and drawdown act as risk controls and dividend yield supports shareholder-return discipline.

excluded_core_factors.name: low_price_to_book
excluded_core_factors.reason: Basket-level evidence remains weak or negative.

excluded_core_factors.name: free_cash_flow_yield
excluded_core_factors.reason: Current PIT coverage and incremental contribution remain insufficient for a core factor.

excluded_core_factors.name: low_vol_score
excluded_core_factors.reason: Used as a risk/coverage gate rather than a positive score after V5.6b ablation.

defensive_rule.reason: V5.6c tests cross-sectional signal definition only; it does not add timing defense.

individual_stop_loss_take_profit.reason: Fixed exits are not part of the research hypothesis.

validation.acceptance_rule: PM cannot accept the basket from 2021-2026 platform-confirmation returns alone. Promotion requires stable evidence, clean data gates, overfit audit, platform attribution and paper trading.
